_note: ('What this points to was deleted' + 'The notification is kept, but
there's nothing to jump to.') is REMOVED from NotificationPanel.tsx —
nothing about a null actionUrl says the target was deleted; most
linkless notifications (account security, billing) never had a target
at all. This is CLAUDE.md's behaviour-precedence case: the board draws
the band, but the claim it makes is factually unsupportable by the data
the server sends, and the ledger's decision-free fix for A-20 is
binding over the visual. The `jump-gone`/`jump-gone-title`/
`jump-gone-body` targets below are gone with it — this recipe now only
proves the row itself renders as non-interactive. If 165:71 is revisited
in Figma to match, re-add targets against the new board reading.
REACHED VIA PROBE: the list is a dashboard tRPC read (NotificationService
-> api-client, superjson), so the probe answers that one request and lets
the real panel, the real service and the real ordering run. Nothing about
the markup is re-implemented.
